decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp still fits the firm's ergonomic workplace offering, but as a smaller standalone line it is more exposed to portfolio simplification than core building-lighting systems.
This general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's mainstream application-focused building-lighting business and remains well aligned with its established range.

The marine HMI searchlight serves a known niche, but its older HMI technology fits poorly with the firm's push toward sustainable, intelligent and LED-based lighting, making withdrawal the more likely choice.

The marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's specialist lighting offer for demanding transport and marine environments, though its niche position leaves some ongoing rationalization risk.
